description: NCI CACTUS one-shot lookup: given any chemical identifier (name, CAS, SMILES, InChI, or InChIKey), return SMILES, InChIKey, IUPAC name, molecular formula, molecular weight, and CAS number in a single call. Fields that cannot be resolved are returned as null. Keyless, plain-text API.

identifier.description: Chemical name, CAS number, SMILES, InChI, or InChIKey (e.g. "ibuprofen", "15687-27-1").

name: identify
title: Identify
